top_signals.title: Japan’s Two-Year Bond Yield Nears 2% as BOJ Rate Hike Bets Mount
top_signals.summary: Japan’s two-year government bond yield is closing in on the key 2% threshold as investors ramp up bets on further Bank of Japan rate hikes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Kalshi loses appeal over Ohio and Tennessee sports betting laws, widening circuit split
top_signals.summary: A federal appeals court ruled on Friday that Kalshi has not adequately shown its sports event contracts are swaps under the Commodity Exchange Act.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
